note: Ground truth for the photos in the folder Dataset. A person (assisted by a tool) looked at each photo with the boxes of the detector drawn on it, and chose the box that frames the speckled bottle. A photo with an empty list has no speckled bottle. The boxes are in the pixels of the stored image (the photo after storage.prepare_image).

remarks.3: The bottle is in a hand, close to the camera, and blurred by motion.
remarks.8: The bottle is held right against the camera. It is huge, out of focus and cut by the corner of the picture.
remarks.14: The bottle is small and far away, at the back of a desk.
